controlling_boundaries: ALG-NPL-019 is Gil Marer and Aweswell's attributed allegation, not a judicial or prosecutorial finding.
Split credit, multiple lives and NPL fraud are analytical labels, not standalone offences.

The original corporate/product lane Caja Insular-La Caja de Canarias to BFA to Bankia to CaixaBank is distinct from the later mortgage-asset lane Bankia to SAREB to Promontoria Holding 122 B.V. to Construcciones Acosta Matos, S.A.
Promontoria Holding 122 B.V. is the controlled entity; no source presently establishes Promontoria Holding 1112, PH11 or Promotoria as the relevant holder.
Haya is treated only as servicer/interlocutor; Cerberus ownership, control, mandate, instruction, knowledge and benefit require actor-specific proof.
The located Arrecife initiating claim concerns the second facility; the record does not yet establish that both mortgage facilities were independently enforced there.
A discount on an NPL or recovery above acquisition price is not itself fraud or unjust enrichment.
An authentic notarial deed may reproduce disputed party recitals without establishing falsity of the instrument or knowledge by the notary.

Document falsity requires the exact document, comparator, author, essential alteration/simulation/false attribution, knowledge and use; procedural fraud additionally requires deception, judicial error, adverse resolution and economic harm.
The present record does not prove false signatures, physical or digital alteration, notarial knowledge, collusion, a common criminal plan or completed offence elements.
